heading.html: What is the Skin Plus Facial?

children.text: The Skin Plus Facial combines two powerful technologies—radio frequency and SONO—to provide a comprehensive skin rejuvenation treatment. These technologies work together to lift, hydrate, and smooth your skin, offering visible, long-lasting results.

children.cls: elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-30527997 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default

  • Penetrate deep into the dermis for effective skin tightening.

children.text: SONO technology uses sound waves to improve hydration and enhance nutrient absorption. During the facial, the ultrasound waves:

heading.html: How It Works: The Skin Plus Facial Process

children.text: The Skin Plus Facial is a non-invasive, step-by-step process that combines radio frequency and SONO to rejuvenate your skin. Here’s how each part of the treatment works:

children.cls: elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-7bc624fe expect-num-col elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default
elementor-element elementor-element-f43fd35 elementor-icon-list--layout-traditional elementor-list-item-link-full_width elementor-widget elementor-widget-icon-list
children.html:
• Preparation: A special gel is applied to the skin to facilitate the smooth movement of the RF pins.
  • Pin Application: Small, gentle pins are used to deliver controlled radio frequency energy into the dermis (deeper skin layers).
  • Collagen Stimulation: The RF energy heats the skin’s layers, triggering the production of collagen and elastin to tighten and firm the skin.

children.cls: elementor-element elementor-element-5dcb5903 elementor-icon-list--layout-traditional elementor-list-item-link-full_width elementor-widget elementor-widget-icon-list
children.html:
• Sound Wave Technology: After the RF treatment, SONO technology uses ultrasonic sound waves to penetrate deep into the skin, opening the pores for better absorption.
  • Serum Infusion: Hydrating serums and nutrients are applied and deeply absorbed into the skin, improving hydration and reducing puffiness.
  • Circulation Boost: SONO also enhances blood flow, giving your skin a refreshed, glowing look.

children.cls: elementor-element elementor-element-52cb94b5 elementor-icon-list--layout-traditional elementor-list-item-link-full_width elementor-widget elementor-widget-icon-list
children.html:
• Calming and Soothing: A cooling mask or treatment is applied to calm the skin, leaving it smooth and revitalized.
  • Results: Immediate effects of smoother, firmer, and more hydrated skin are visible, with ongoing improvements as collagen production continues.

heading.html: Who Is the Skin Plus Facial For?

children.text: The Skin Plus Facial is an advanced, non-invasive treatment designed for individuals looking to rejuvenate their skin without the need for surgery or downtime. Combining the power of radio frequency and SONO technologies, this facial targets a wide range of skin concerns, from fine lines and wrinkles to sagging skin and uneven texture. Whether you’re looking to improve skin tone, firm areas of concern, or simply achieve a more radiant complexion, the Skin Plus Facial offers a customized solution that’s suitable for most skin types and concerns.

children.cls: elementor-element elementor-element-35d8d52a elementor-icon-list--layout-traditional elementor-list-item-link-full_width elementor-widget elementor-widget-icon-list
children.html:
• Want to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
  • Are seeking non-surgical skin tightening and lifting.
  • Have uneven skin texture or tone that needs smoothing.
  • Desire deep hydration and a more youthful, glowing complexion.
  • Are concerned with loose or sagging skin in areas like the jawline or under-eye region.

  • Long-term Benefits: Collagen production continues to enhance your skin’s firmness and texture, with optimal results appearing within 2–4 weeks after your treatment.

heading.html: Frequently Asked Questions about the Skin Plus Facial

children.html:
What is the Skin Plus Facial?
The Skin Plus Facial is a non-invasive skin rejuvenation treatment that combines radio frequency (RF treatment) and SONO technologies. It helps tighten, lift, and hydrate the skin while improving texture and reducing fine lines and wrinkles.
How does the Skin Plus Facial work?
The treatment uses radio frequency to stimulate collagen production and tighten skin, while SONO technology enhances hydration and serum absorption, leaving the skin refreshed and glowing.
Is the Skin Plus Facial safe?
Yes, the Skin Plus Facial is a safe, non-invasive treatment suitable for most skin types. Our trained professionals at King Spa ensure that the treatment is customized to your skin’s specific needs.
Are there any side effects?
There is minimal to no downtime with the Skin Plus Facial. Some individuals may experience mild redness or warmth in the treated areas, but this typically fades within a few hours.
How many treatments will I need to see results?
Results are visible after just one session, but for optimal results, we recommend a series of treatments. Your esthetician will guide you on the best plan for your skin goals.
How long do the results last?
With regular treatments, the results can last for several months, as collagen production continues to improve over time. Maintenance treatments are recommended to sustain your results.
Is the Skin Plus Facial suitable for all skin types?
Yes, the Skin Plus Facial is designed to be effective for all skin types, and it can be tailored to address your unique skin concerns, from fine lines to sagging skin.
